gameDescriptionHtml:
Represent your Corporation as you fight for control over resource-rich part of space. Engage in ship to ship combat, complete randomized missions and claim sectors, expand and upgrade your fleet and take on more difficult enemies.

Game Features

  • DIRECT CONTROL – Directly control any ship in your fleet, switch between them anytime and make sure to maximize their potential.
  • 1ST PERSON FOR FIGHTERS – Fly agile and speedy fighters from inside a cockpit and experience thrilling battles in a first-person perspective.
  • 3RD PERSON FOR LARGE SHIPS – Take control of large ships and their powerful weapon systems in third-person perspective.
  • FLEET COMMAND – Issue orders from a RTS-like view, organize and manage your fleet ship by ship.
  • SHIP CUSTOMIZATION – Buy new ships and customize their loadout weapon by weapon, create a flexible fleet fitting multiple roles based on your needs, or commit your fleet to a specific task and playstyle.
  • CONTRACT SECTORS – Complete randomized contracts of various types in gradually more difficult sectors.
  • CONQUEST SECTORS – Capture Control Points and build defenses in more complex Conquest sectors which require a more strategic approach
